newsitem.title: USA: Cellex unit opens plant in Pennsylvania.
newsitem.headline: Cellex unit opens plant in Pennsylvania.

text.p: Cellex Biosciences Inc said Thursday its LSL Biolafitte Inc subsidiary has opened a U.S. manufacturing plant in Allentown, Pa.
Besides manufacturing stirred tank fermentation and cell culture systems, the new facility also will serve as LSL Biolafitte's U.S. sales office and spare parts distribution center.
Another subsidiary, LSL Biolafitte SA, produces similar products in France.
Cellex provides cell processing products and services to biotechnology markets worldwide.
